Episode 234. To Hell (11)
In front of Jito's residence.
After dealing with the demons sealed in Vascara, Jin continued his meditation without once opening his eyes.
He was waging a war within himself, to master the sword forged to cut Soldrelet, his own god.
Why did Temer invent Solar Splitter to cut Soldrelet?
Knowing that the sword could cut him, why did Soldrelet leave Temer alone?
He didn't worry about such questions. There must have been a good reason, and it wasn't helpful for the immediate fight with Jito.
'The sensation of cutting Soldrelet... It's not easy to understand.'
Imagination is easy.
Jin knew Soldrelet's voice, appearance, and the aura he uses better than anyone else.
So he could imagine cutting Soldrelet over and over again.
But to 'implement' that Soldrelet in the inner world, and to face him as if in reality, was difficult, even with his supernatural intuition.
He tried to implement it clumsily several times. He was continuously performing the Solar Splitter against the implemented Soldrelet.
'But little by little, I'm getting there, I'm sure.'
The first implementation didn't touch at all, and the second one barely grazed.
In the third implementation, he cut Soldrelet in half, but he dispersed like smoke, taking no damage.
But Jin wasn't discouraged at all.
From the beginning, it was impossible to perfectly implement Soldrelet, and it was impossible to cut him within a day, even with an immature implementation.
However, the only way meditation could have meaning was that it was the only means to awaken the sensation of realizing the Solar Splitter for now.
'If I could meet Soldrelet in person, I think I could get an understanding of the Solar Splitter at once, but that's also impossible, so this is the best I can do for now.'
Jin silently cut the Soldrelet in his inner world.

The more he did so, the more he realized how great a god Soldrelet was. He even felt confident that if there was a swordsman who could inflict even a little damage on the real Soldrelet, cutting Jito wouldn't be that difficult for him.
Jin opened his eyes as soon as the promised day passed.
His body was drenched in sweat. But his mood was incredibly refreshed, even though he hadn't even been able to touch the hem of the clothes of Soldrelet, who had been implemented in his inner world.
"[...Has the meditation ended?]"
Visaro spoke, looking back at Jin. He had finished sorting out the dimensional door about an hour ago and had been waiting for Jin.
"Yes, Visaro. You didn't leave."
[I haven't thanked you yet for setting me free.]
Visaro said, looking around Jin. Golden spheres were rising around Jin, who had just finished meditating.
"I don't need thanks. Anyway, it was just a path I had to cross to meet Jito."
[While you were meditating, many demons eroded by Jito's madness passed by.]
"Really? Even though I was focused on meditation, I didn't feel it at all."

[They were like creatures left only with flesh, killing and eating each other. But when they got close to you, they quieted down like pilgrims starting their pilgrimage and then moved away. But once they got out of your influence again, they fought like mad.]
"That's a strange phenomenon. I met many demons eroded by flesh on my way here, but they didn't show me that behavior."

[I may have lost a lot of power, but I was once a being with a divine status. Therefore, I was vaguely aware that you were constantly fighting with some great being in your meditation. I wonder if the demons that passed by during the day... revered that being.]
"Really?"

[As you know, Jito's mental control is absolute. Even witches can't completely break that mental control. They can temporarily mitigate it. The fact that the behavior of the demons changed just by passing near you, it is because the great being you faced in your inner world is related to the Sun God.]
"The Sun God?"

[The Sun God is an absolute being. There may not be many demons who remember the time when he existed, but it's engraved in the mind of all demons now. So no matter how crazy they are with mind control, they become meek sheep when they face the direct traces of the Sun God.]
Jin looked around the golden spheres blooming around him.
'So this was, as Lady Ayura said, a manifestation of the will of the Sun God.'
The spheres were formed regardless of Jin's will and were slowly fading.
[Can you tell me who you were fighting against?]
"It was Soldrelet."
[Soldrelet. It sounds familiar. He is probably... a shadow born from the death of the beginning.]
Jin's eyes widened.
"The beginning of death, does it mean the death of the Sun God?"

[Yes. As far as I know, he's the first immortal that appeared as soon as the Sun God died. So, it makes sense that the insane demons calmed down when they approached you. If it wasn't just the result of your meditation, but the real Solterlet was there, all those demons would instantly escape from madness and regain their peace. Maybe even Zito beyond this gate.]
Bisaro recognized the real Solterlet as a far greater existence that could not even be compared to Zito.
"I'd appreciate it if you could tell me everything you know about Solterlet."
[Unfortunately, that's all I know. It's a miracle that I remember even this much. I've been through numerous cycles of oblivion and sealing.]
"One of my comrades is a wizard who can restore memories. Could you help me with her aid?"
Bisaro nodded his head.

[Of course…… not only the demons driven mad by Zito were affected by you. I also felt comfortable all the while you were meditating. I'm curious about why the dead Sun God left such an impact on the world.]
"It seems I encountered a noble on my way."
[That's what my dead friends and I should say. So...are you going to challenge Zito now?]
"I was thinking about it, but my comrades haven't arrived yet."
While the timing of Murakan and Veil could be uncertain, Valeria was never a person to miss the timing.
However, Jin was not very worried about them. Murakan, who had regained Mui, wouldn't be in a 'danger that he couldn't even run away from', even if there were minor side effects.
Moreover, the most dangerous being in the Demon World was now beyond the gate in front of Jin.
'It's highly likely that they got involved with something while searching for Bicepts...'
There was no other case where Valeria would miss the timing.
'Valeria would not have made a wrong judgement. So, I'm thinking that it might be good for me to go with her and handle that problem first.'
The problem was that there was no way to find Valeria right away.
In Hell, the wave tracking communication device could not be used, and Jin could not fly like Murakan to quickly search the area.
Although he could move around while scanning a wide area with his Changseong senses, there was a chance they might miss each other.
"I think we should wait a little longer."

[That's right, no matter how strong you are, it's madness to face Zito alone in Hell. Unless it's a being like Solterlet or a witch, any immortal would avoid fighting with him in his realm. Every immortal shows their greatest power when they are in their own domain.]

[That's right, Jin. Although I talked about him as if he was nothing, that's based on the assumption that I fought him in my territory with my original power. If Zito regains all his power and invades the earth, you and your comrades won't be able to handle him.]
In the past, Tes had said something similar. That Jito's 'essential nature' was not much different from his own.
"Visaro, who do you think will win in your view?"
["...Honestly? Or a somewhat deceptive answer?"]
"I don’t need to hear it."
["But you're a being who has transcended fate. Moreover, you're the one chosen by Sol Deret, so my judgement is meaningless. Until you fight, no one can know the outcome."]
"While waiting for my companions, it seems fine to continue meditating."
Visaro had no answer.
Suddenly, two huge arms sprung from the dimensional gate, attacking Visaro and Jin.
Kreuk-!
Visaro was instantly crushed into meat, and Jin cut off the arm trying to grab him with his sword.
It was Jito's arm.
[Kkkkkk!]
Then, a unique crude and dreadful voice echoed from inside the dimensional gate. The arm cut off by Jin's sword transformed into magic and was absorbed by another arm that had newly appeared.
Two arms appearing from the inside were widening the narrow gap of the dimensional gate. The dimensional gate was torn apart in an instant, and the scenery changed.
It was the space known as 'Jito's Dwelling.' In that dark realm, countless stakes rose, and all sorts of lives and souls hung like grapevines.
[Ah! You have to wait more, Jin Runkundel. Do you know how much effort I've put in to play with you so far? Huh?]
Thump-! Thump......!
Jito's footsteps were heard from beyond the darkness. The huge arms that just opened the dimensional gate were again scattered into magic and gathered towards Jito.
[Weren't you also expecting it? Our date like this. Heh…… my lovely toy that finally bore the fruit of creation after going through numerous hurdles. From today, we will live happily here......!]
Jin silently glared at Jito.
Ten pairs of wings, spikes all over his body, and two spiked axes. Although his size was much smaller than before, the aura that radiated from him was incomparably dangerous and sharp.
"A god who can't be patient."

[I prefer to be called a demon king rather than a god. A demon king doesn’t need to be patient, right? Hehe, originally, I was going to eat your friends as well. But due to Kelliac, the kids are a little hurt…….]
Jin did not ask if he knew about Murakan and the others. He didn't worry about them when he heard the phrase "they're hurt".
Instead, he just pointed his sword and said,
